Paragraph: "What for you have come into these perilous forests hemming in Pampa Lake along with your brother, for these are impenetrable forests abounding with many a serpent and animal?" Thus Hanuma asked Rama.
Situation/Problem_Faced: Inquiring about the reason for the princes' dangerous journey into the deep forest.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Hanuman directly asks Rama for the background of their presence in the wilderness.
Outcome/Resolution: Invites the sharing of their narrative.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Anxiety: Concern and wariness regarding safety in a perilous environment

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Hanuman poses an open inquiry (prasna) to understand the truth behind their exile.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Encouraging narrative disclosure through respectful, direct questioning.
